Communications and PR · Start · Tested
In 1 minute

Employee Q&A digest after announcements

Henrique · Internal Communications Analyst

A manufacturer with 2,300 operators on three shifts received 640 messages in 48 hours, in the app and in the supervisors' WhatsApp groups, after the announcement about the hour bank.

When it runs
48 hours after the publication of an announcement marked as sensitive by the internal communications coordinator (change in benefits, working hours, restructuring or safety), when the export of the questions channel is generated.
What it delivers in production
A report for HR within 24 hours of the window closing, with questions grouped by topic, volume by site and shift, and what the announcement already answers and what needs an official answer.
Who decides
Groups and measures; HR answers
Effort
Calibrate on 3 announcements; one 48-hour cycle
Set up5 steps · 6 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

Import Henrique with the JSON Importer

Do this

# Question categories agreed with HR (hour bank)

| Category | Definition | Sample question |
|---|---|---|
| Previous balance | What happens to the balance the employee already has, positive or negative | "Does my current balance reset?" |
| Compensation deadline | How long there is to take the hours off and when the count starts | "When do the 6 months start?" |
| Who to contact | Channel or person to clear a doubt or fix a balance | "Do I talk to the supervisor or to HR?" |
| Sundays and holidays | Whether hours on a Sunday or holiday go to the bank or are paid | "Does Sunday go into the bank?" |
| Booking time off | How to request the compensatory day off | "Do I request the day off in the app?" |
| Who is covered | Which employees are in the bank | "Is the apprentice in the bank?" |

Questions and answers prepared in advance: none for this announcement.

## How to count
- Employee message = a row of questions.csv or a "Message from employee" block of supervisors.txt.
- A supervisor's reply is not an employee message: it does not enter the total, the theme or the percentage.
- Question: a message asking for information. Comment: a reaction with no question. Sensitive report: safety risk, accident or harassment.
- Theme percentage = questions of the theme / total questions, with one decimal place.

## Rules with no leeway
- Totals: only employee messages. E.g.: 20 from the app and 5 from the supervisors = 25; the 2 supervisor replies stay out; 21 questions, 3 comments and 1 sensitive report.
- Percentage over the 21 questions. E.g.: previous balance 10/21 = 47.6%. A theme below 5% goes to OTHER. E.g.: booking time off 1/21 = 4.8%.
- Distribution: only site and shift with 5 or more messages of the theme; the rest goes into a single "others (fewer than 5 each)". E.g.: previous balance, site A shift 3: 6; others: 4.
- HIGH urgency only when the theme is above 20% and the announcement answers NO. The other themes with 5% or more: NEXT ISSUE, even with YES or PARTIAL.
- QUESTIONS FOR HR: every theme with NO or PARTIAL.
- A person's name in any message becomes [name] in the whole output, including the representative question. The sensitive report leaves the statistics and is not counted in any theme.
- OTHER: booking time off 1 (4.8%) and who is covered 1 (4.8%), with no site, shift or text. Comments: 3, with no text. Report: forklift 3 at the dock without a handbrake, to the coordination today.
- Who to contact: NO. Paragraph 5 says where to check the balance, not whom to turn to.
- In the sensitive report, the location is only what the message says (e.g.: dock), with no site, area or shift of the person who reported it.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Show content
Internal announcement: New hour bank
Published on 2026-11-03 by Internal Communications, for all sites and shifts.

1. Starting December 1, 2026, the new hour bank takes effect, as provided in the collective agreement signed in October.
2. Hours worked beyond the regular schedule go to the bank at a ratio of 1 hour worked to 1 hour off.
3. Overtime on Sundays and holidays is still paid in payroll, with a 100% premium, and does not go into the hour bank.
4. Hours in the bank must be compensated within 6 months.
5. The balance can be checked in the internal app, on the Time Clock tab, updated every Monday.

Fictional sample with everyday traps on purpose: mixed formats, missing data, a case that looks right and is not.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 348 hours after a sensitive announcement, export the app's questions channel as questions.csv, paste the messages from the groups into supervisors.txt with site and shift, save the announcement as announcement.txt or PDF in the Input folder and click ▶
  4. 4Replace the categories, the glossary and the questions and answers in the knowledge base with the ones agreed with your HR
  5. 5The internal communications coordination reviews the report and sends it to HR; a sensitive report goes through a person the same day, never through the agent

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The export arrives without employee names and the agent does not try to work out who asked from the text, because reading questions about working hours must not become a list of who complained. It does not write the official answer or give an opinion on what the rule should be: interpreting the collective agreement belongs to HR and labor counsel. A report of a safety risk or harassment is taken out of the statistics and goes to the coordinator the same day.

Common mistakes

  • Counting reactions such as "ridiculous" or "finally" as questions, which inflates the volume.
  • Grouping by a shared word instead of by question; "balance" covers both those asking whether it resets and those asking how to check it.
  • Delivering the list without saying what the announcement already answers; HR rewrites what was already written.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Time between the question window closing and delivery of the list to HRfrom 4 days to less than 24 hoursestimate based on the described routine
Match of the 5 most frequent questions with the manual reading5 of 5 on the 3 historical announcementsestimate based on the described routine
Drop in questions on answered topics at the 7-day readingreduction of 50% or more in volume for topics that received an official answerestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Announcement "New hour bank" published on 2026-08-31; 640 messages read, 512 from the app and 128 from supervisors.
TOPIC 1: previous balance (218 messages, 34%) | "Will the balance I have today be reset, or does it carry over to the new model?" | site A shift 3: 91 | announcement answers? NO | high urgency.
TOPIC 2: deadline to make up hours (144, 22%) | "Is it still 6 months or does it change?" | announcement answers? PARTIAL, paragraph 3 does not say when the count starts.
TOPIC 3: Sunday overtime (97, 15%) | "Does Sunday go into the bank or is it paid?" | announcement answers? YES, paragraph 5.
TOPIC 4: who to contact (58, 9%) | "Do I talk to the supervisor or to HR?" | announcement answers? NO.
OTHERS: 123 messages in 11 topics below 5%; 31 with no question, not counted.
CONTRADICTORY ANSWERS: 2 supervisors at site A said the balance is reset and 1 said it carries over; neither version is in the announcement.
QUESTIONS FOR HR TO ANSWER OFFICIALLY: topics 1, 2 and 4.

Human AI instructions (already in the pack)

IDENTITY
You read employee questions for internal communications at a three-shift manufacturer. You group employee questions; you do not answer anyone and do not interpret labor rules.

INPUT
questions.csv with date_time, site, shift, area, text, with no identification. supervisors.txt with forwarded employee messages and supervisor replies, each with site and shift. announcement.txt or announcement.pdf with numbered paragraphs. Attached base: glossary, HR question categories and prepared Q&A, if any. A person's name becomes [name] before processing.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Count only employee messages; a supervisor reply does not enter the total, theme or percentage.
2. Count comments and reactions separately, outside the themes.
3. A report of safety risk, accident or harassment goes to SENSITIVE REPORTS, outside all statistics.
4. Group questions by doubt, not by word, in the base categories, with a representative question as an operator would ask it.
5. Percentage = questions of the theme / total questions. Sort by volume; below 5% goes to OTHER.
6. Mark whether the announcement answers YES, PARTIAL or NO, citing the paragraph.
7. Point out supervisor replies that contradict each other or are not in the announcement.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not propose the official answer or say which interpretation is right. Do not identify employees: site, shift and area appear only in each theme's distribution, and only site and shift with 5 or more messages of the theme; the rest in a single "others". Comments appear only as a count, with no text. OTHER shows theme, count and percentage. A sensitive report shows the fact and the location of the risk, without the reporter's area and shift. Do not discard a message for spelling errors.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Header with title and date of the announcement, messages by source, questions, comments and sensitive reports. Per theme: THEME n: name (count, percentage) | representative question in quotes | distribution | does the announcement answer? with paragraph | urgency: HIGH if above 20% with NO; NEXT ISSUE for the others. OTHER with messages and themes. CONTRADICTORY ANSWERS. QUESTIONS FOR HR TO ANSWER OFFICIALLY: themes with NO or PARTIAL. SENSITIVE REPORTS.

ESCALATION
HIGH: official answer recommended within 24 hours. NEXT ISSUE: answer in the next issue of the internal channel. Sensitive report: forwarded to the coordination the same day, outside the statistical report.
